scope: Independent mother-surface geometry, actual STL normal-ray wall samples, eye insertion and eye-aperture comparison. Full assembly and topology are reported separately by validate_mesh.py.

mother_surface.note: Mother source-core preservation is not a claim that the remeshed print surface is pointwise identical to v8; source-surface audit is separate.

actual_print_self_intersection.limitations: Any pair sharing a vertex is excluded. This does not prove neighboring triangles cannot overlap elsewhere away from that shared vertex. It is distinct from the assembly intersection check.

wall_samples.classification_evidence: All 17 sub-2mm ear-neighborhood outer hits match original ear triangles within 0.0015–0.0190mm; they are separately retained, not omitted.
wall_samples.limit: Discrete normal-ray samples, not a mathematical global minimum-wall proof.

eye_apertures.note: Small remeshing edge-pixel changes exist; aperture is not claimed exactly pixel-identical.

curvature_evidence.note: One mid-sagittal upper-forehead profile supports removal of the prior artificial shoulder; this does not claim every facial/ear cross-section is globally convex.

physical_fit: No physical print, eye installation or cap-fit test has been performed.

assembly_and_topology.reason: Complete rounded cranium reconstructed while retaining facial scale; 190mm was an earlier design target, not an exact user size constraint.

blend_stl_consistency.comparison: Evaluated Blender world-space loop triangles cast to float32; vertices within each triangle and triangle collections canonicalized, then compared exactly, including float32 bits.
